conviction_note: Abs move 8.5 (event-implied 7.51, straddle 8.22, Benzinga 9.1; a first Q3 guide covering the GTA VI launch quarter is likely) times a 47% up probability gives -0.51. The lean is slightly negative: a 13% run-up week, calls bid on the front expiry, a management that said in August it would not raise before a unit had sold (still true on 9 Nov), and 5 of 7 prior prints sold. Pull toward 50: unprecedented third-party pre-order data at a ~$97 ASP against a guide that Wells Fargo reads as 33m units at $80, plus a -27 vol-point skew that pays for upside. The two measurements agree in sign and are close in size (findings sum -0.5 vs -0.51 scaled), so both are near a non-result.
bar: Q2 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026) net bookings guide $1,620-1,670m, GAAP revenue $1,420-1,470m, GAAP EPS $(0.84)-(0.75) (company 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000946581/000162828026054580/ttwo1q27earningsrelease.htm). Street net bookings about $1.66bn (Earnings Whispers via https://finviz.com/news/413875/take-two-faces-a-final-pre-gta-vi-test-as-shares-slide-toward-range-lows and Benzinga/Koyfin via https://coincentral.com/take-two-interactive-ttwo-stock-climbs-13-ahead-of-earnings-and-gta-vi-launch/), in the upper half of the guide; two sources agree. The EPS bar is disputed: -0.86 GAAP (Benzinga) against +0.90 to +0.98 adjusted (EW, Koyfin, GuruFocus); whisper $1.05. FY27 net bookings guide $8.0-8.2bn reiterated in August; the Street was around $8.6bn in August (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/two-earnings-preview-strauss-zelnick-163722348.html). No current FY27 or Q3 (Oct-Dec) consensus found. The line the stock trades on is the FY27/Q3 guide and GTA VI commentary, not Q2.
positioning_check: Short interest 9,627,429 shares on the 2026-10-15 settlement, about 5.15% of shares outstanding, 3.80 days to cover. It has risen from 6.39m on 2026-07-31 to 9.30m on 09-30 and 9.63m on 10-15 (https://equibles.com/stocks/ttwo/shortinterest; the 10-30 print is due 11-10). That is not a crowded short. Skew_25d is -26.93 vol points, so 25-delta calls are far richer than puts and the option market pays for upside. Put/call open interest is 3.66, which looks like stock-holder hedges. The event-implied move is 7.51% on the Nov 13 expiry, which ends before the Nov 19 launch. The 5-day run-up is +8.89% (a +13% week to $214.87 on Nov 6, the best in nearly five months), and the stock was $209.18 intraday on Nov 9. It is -19% from its 52-week high and +10% above its 52-week low. Insiders sold about $165m over the past year with no buys (coincentral). Macquarie initiated Outperform with a $300 target on Nov 6.

findings.finding: Sensor Tower estimates 7.71m digital GTA VI pre-orders worth about $751m through about Nov 3, an average of roughly $97 a copy. Weekly pre-orders accelerated to about 790k from 470k the week before, and in August 89% of pre-orders were the $99.99 Ultimate Edition. Wells Fargo estimates the $8.0-8.2bn FY27 guide assumes 33m copies at $80. Pre-order units and ASP are running richer than that assumption, which gives management room to set a strong Q3 guide or raise FY27. Digital only; physical copies are excluded.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GTA VI news has moved the stock 5-6% either way intraday: about +5% on pre-order and date confirmation, -6.2% on the Aug 31 leaks (https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/15498748952847360). On the guide line, the stock fell -4.42% when the FY27 guide came in conservative (May 2026) and rose +6.04% in August when it was reiterated with a Q1 beat (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The data went public on Nov 5, inside the +13% week, and the -27 skew already pays for upside. What is not priced is whether management converts it into a number: a Q3 guide or an FY27 raise. If the market had fully priced a raise, the stock would sit near the $262-330 analyst targets rather than 19% below its 52-week high.
findings.independence: Same tracker, separate article: https://tribune.com.pk/story/2638791/gta-6-reportedly-generates-751m-in-pre-orders-ahead-of-launch (one source, Sensor Tower, so it counts once). Ultimate Edition mix from August: https://rockstarintel.com/89-of-gta-6-pre-orders-are-for-the-ultimate-edition/. Wells Fargo's 33m/$80 read of the guide: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/two-earnings-preview-strauss-zelnick-163722348.html. Sony raised its FY G&NS outlook on third-party software (separate finding).

findings.finding: On the Q1 FY27 call management refused to raise the $8.0-8.2bn FY27 guide because 'we haven't sold one unit yet' and 'you can cancel a preorder'. It called itself 'allergic to victory laps' and flagged possible demand pull-forward. That reasoning is unchanged on Nov 9, ten days before launch, so a reiteration is the likely FY27 line, against a Street that sat around $8.6bn in August, above the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2026 FY27 guide (conservative versus the Street) brought -4.42%. The Nov 2025 print (raise plus a GTA delay) brought -8.08%. The Feb 2026 print (raise to $6.7bn) brought -5.38%. The Aug 2026 reiteration with a beat brought +6.04% (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Earnings Whispers says the Street does not expect a raise, and the stock still sits 19% below its high. If a reiteration were fully absorbed, the stock would not have run 13% into the print with calls bid, which suggests some holders are positioned for a raise or a strong pre-order number.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview, which says the Street does not expect a raise and the guide was not raised: https://finviz.com/news/413875/take-two-faces-a-final-pre-gta-vi-test-as-shares-slide-toward-range-lows. Wells Fargo expects no numerical pre-order disclosure (Benzinga via Yahoo, above).

findings.finding: BTIG cut its target to $262 from $313 on Nov 4 (Buy kept), citing weaker mobile data and lower NBA 2K forecasts from reviews and user data. This lands on Q2, which the company already guided to RCS of about -5% with mobile down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 beat the top of the bookings guide on NBA 2K/GTA with mobile -7%, and the stock rose +6.04%. Reported-quarter beats on this name have mostly been sold (5 of 7 prints down).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The note is public and the stock rose 2.1% that day. Mobile softness is inside the company's own guide (RCS -5%, Color Block Jam lapping), so it moves the stock only if mobile comes in below even that.
findings.independence: The company guided Q2 RCS to about -5% with mobile lower and blamed UA cost pressure on the Q1 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15401384786732032). Partly offset by NBA 2K27's Circana rank (next finding). Net of the rest of the company: GTA/NBA RCS is guided to grow.

findings.finding: Circana's September 2026 chart (8/30-10/3) has NBA 2K27 #2 for the month behind Marvel's Wolverine and #1 year-to-date in US dollar sales. It led August after its Aug 26 early-access launch. That supports a Q2 bookings result at or above the $1.66bn consensus despite poor user reviews.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 beat the top of the guide on NBA 2K and the stock rose +6.04%. Earlier beats were sold.
findings.why_not_priced: A public chart, and NBA 2K is guided to high-single-digit growth for FY27, so it sits largely inside the guide. Only the size of the beat is open. It is a US-only dollar rank with no unit comparison against NBA 2K26.
findings.independence: August lead: https://gamingbolt.com/nba-2k27-is-already-the-3rd-best-selling-game-of-2026-in-the-us-after-5-days. It cuts against BTIG's lower NBA 2K forecasts (previous finding); the two are not contradictory (dollar rank versus RCS/engagement).

findings.finding: Sony (Nov 5) reported Jul-Sep G&NS sales +9%, software +12.5%, network services +19.7% and a record 127m PSN MAU. It raised its full-year G&NS revenue and operating-income forecasts by 6%, citing stronger third-party software and digital services. PS5 holds about 74% of GTA VI digital pre-orders per Sensor Tower.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline record of a reaction to counterparty guidance.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it landed inside TTWO's +13% week. It is a proxy, because Sony does not name GTA VI, so its reach to TTWO's guide is inferred.
findings.independence: Proxy. Platform split from https://www.ggrecon.com/articles/gta-6-pre-orders-sensor-tower/. Microsoft's Xbox content and services fell -2% in the same quarter (https://www.invenglobal.com/articles/27860/xbox-content-and-services-revenue-declines-for-fourth-consecutive-quarter), a mildly opposite platform read.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is long and recent. The stock rose 13% in the week to Nov 6, its best week in nearly five months (+8.89% over 5 sessions in the baseline). 25-delta calls trade 27 vol points over puts on the Nov 13 expiry, which ends before the Nov 19 launch. Macquarie initiated at $300 on Nov 6. Short interest is only 5.15% / 3.8 days, so a squeeze is a weak mechanism. A 'final pre-launch print' with GTA unit sales still unknown leaves room for sell-the-news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 5 of 7 prior prints were down (median |move| 5.38%). Of the two up prints, +6.04% in Aug 2026 came after a 17.7% decline into the print and +14.03% in Feb 2025 came on a raise.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew says the option market leans up. This finding argues against it because the call premium on an expiry before launch reads as speculative demand following a 13% week rather than information, and the print cannot show GTA units. If the market had priced a sell-the-news risk, the run-up would have stalled at the call bid; instead the stock was only -2.6% off Friday's close intraday Monday.
findings.independence: Short-interest series: https://equibles.com/stocks/ttwo/shortinterest. Skew and run-up from the sealed baseline (not a URL). Prior to the run-up the stock was at $192 on Nov 2 (https://finviz.com/news/413875/take-two-faces-a-final-pre-gta-vi-test-as-shares-slide-toward-range-lows).

findings.why_not_priced: It is public and preceded the run-up, so it is largely priced. It bears on FY28 rather than this print's lines unless the cut reflects lower FY27 GTA assumptions, which the source does not say.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative (long run-up, a management that will not raise, a history of selling prints) against a -27 vol-point skew that pays for upside and a 13% run-up the market has already chosen. They cut against the skew, so p_up was pulled from about 45 to 47 and every negative was trimmed.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a reaction; this name sold 5 of 7 prints): pre-order finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7.
Lesson 3 (my own caveat: the Street already expects no raise): reiteration finding cut from -1.0 to -0.7.
Lessons 6 and 9 (inside guided RCS -5%; size a segment net of the rest): BTIG mobile/NBA finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3 and the NBA 2K27 Circana finding from +0.4 to +0.3.
Lesson 5 (proxy, partly priced): Sony finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 7 (a sign against a strong skew needs a reason or a smaller size): positioning finding cut from -0.8 to -0.6, with the reason stated, and p_up moved from 46 to 47.
File, do not veto ('rules resize; they do not veto'): the BofA target cut, set aside in the draft, is now filed as a -0.1 finding.
